# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 years old during early school days  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v2 c16 P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde has dark eyes and shiny, dark hair.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022)_

## Personality

Isolde is an affectionate, enthusiastic, and sensitive companion who easily gets caught up in dramatic ideas and imaginative stories. Though self-deprecating about her intellect and less resilient than her close friend, she is supportive, loyal, and generous with her praise.

_Sources: [v2 c16 P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024), [v2 c16 P27](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0027), [v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045), [v3 c11 P43](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

- Affectionate
- Self-deprecating  <sub>[v2 c26 P45](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0045)</sub>
- Fear of growing stout in middle age  <sub>[v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056)</sub>

## Abilities

- Making lettuce salad  <sub>[v2 c16 P25](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0025)</sub>
- Creating red tissue paper bookmarks
- Understanding geometry better than Nell  <sub>[v1 c17 P39](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0039)</sub>

## History

Isolde Pembroke grew up at Pear Hill overlooking Pembroke's pond. During her school days at Brierley, she formed a deep, emotional friendship with Nell Harcourt. After participating in a prank that inadvertently frightened a visiting guest, Miss Pembroke, she stood by in apprehension while Nell helped resolve the tension. Following the visit, Miss Pembroke gifted Isolde a silver bangle bracelet. While Nell went on to join the Regent's class to pursue teaching, Isolde's parents did not plan to send her, causing her path to temporarily diverge from Nell's, though they remained close. She frequently shared gossip, comforted Nell about her freckles, helped with preparations for guests, and remained a faithful confidante when Nell harbored ambitions of writing fiction.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c19 P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c16 P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024), [v2 c16 P27](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0027), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v3 c11 P43](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0043)_

## Background by volume

- Was named at birth by a schoolmaster who was lodging at her family's house  <sub>[v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064)</sub>
- Attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)</sub>
- Was a former member of a Story Club with Nell  <sub>[v3 c11 P43](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0043)</sub>
